# Velair 1.5.0

Velair 1.5.0 expands language support, clarifies how Profiles and Modes work,
refines the active setup chooser, and refreshes the project branding.

## ✨ Added

- Added complete German, French, and Dutch translations for the Velair panel,
  optional Lovelace card, Home Assistant setup, entities, and states. Regional
  variants use the matching language and localized date and time formatting.

## 🚀 Improved

- Updated installation guidance now that Velair is available directly from the
  default HACS store without adding a custom repository.
- Updated the Velair logo assets with dedicated standard and high-resolution
  versions for clearer rendering.
- Clarified how Profiles and Modes work together. Direct Profile activation
  replaces the active set, and zones no longer covered immediately return to
  their Default schedules. Use a Mode to activate several non-overlapping
  Profiles together.
- Made Manual a display-only state in Velair's chooser. Direct Profile
  activation enters this state, while Default or a custom Mode leaves it. The
  native Home Assistant selector retains Manual for compatibility; selecting it
  keeps the active Profiles and only detaches them from their custom Mode.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed a Chrome tab crash that could occur when clicking explanatory text in
  the Mode and Profile chooser while preserving click-outside dismissal.

## 🧭 Notes

- Update through HACS when possible, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the
  browser or companion app after installing the release.
- When using the optional Lovelace cards, confirm that
  `/velair_frontend/velair-card.js` is registered as a JavaScript module. See
  the Troubleshooting guide if a card shows a configuration error.
